name: mobile phone
use: Calls, messages, internet, UPI payments and photos.
tip: Keep it away from water and heat; lock it with a PIN or fingerprint.

name: wallet
tip: Carry only the cards you need; keep a photo of your IDs in case it's lost.

name: keys
use: Open locks for the home, vehicle or cupboard.
tip: Keep a spare key with someone you trust.

name: eyeglasses
use: Correct vision or protect the eyes.
tip: Clean lenses with a microfiber cloth, not a shirt, to avoid scratches.

name: sunglasses
use: Protect eyes from bright sunlight and UV.
tip: Choose lenses marked UV400 for real UV protection.

name: wrist watch
use: Shows the time; smartwatches also track health.
tip: Remove it before swimming unless it is rated water-resistant.

name: backpack
use: Carries books, laptop and daily items.
tip: Use both straps and keep heavy items close to your back.

name: handbag
use: Carries personal items when going out.
tip: Zip it shut in crowded places.

name: umbrella
use: Protection from rain and strong sun.
tip: Dry it open before folding so it doesn't rust or smell.

name: water bottle
tip: Wash it daily; steel bottles are better than reusing thin plastic ones.

name: id card
use: Proves identity, like Aadhaar, PAN or a college ID.
tip: Never share a full photo of your Aadhaar; use the masked version.

name: credit card
tip: Never share the OTP or CVV with anyone, even if they claim to be the bank.

name: coin
tip: Keep coins away from small children; they are a choking hazard.

name: banknote
tip: Check the security thread and watermark if a note looks suspicious.

name: comb
tip: Don't share combs, to avoid spreading lice or scalp infections.

name: hair dryer
tip: Keep it away from water and unplug it after use.

name: perfume bottle
tip: Store away from sunlight so the scent lasts longer.

name: lipstick
tip: Replace it after about a year; old makeup can grow bacteria.

name: necktie
tip: Hang ties instead of folding them to avoid creases.

name: cap
use: Shades the face from the sun.
tip: Wear one outdoors in summer to lower the risk of heatstroke.

name: t-shirt
tip: Wash dark colours inside out to keep them from fading.

name: socks
use: Keep feet warm and dry inside shoes.
tip: Change socks daily to prevent fungal infections.

name: shoes
tip: Air them out regularly; damp shoes cause odour and fungus.

name: slippers
tip: Choose ones with a good grip for wet bathroom floors.

name: saree
tip: Store silk sarees in cotton cloth, not plastic.

name: helmet
use: Protects the head on a two-wheeler.
tip: Always strap it; an unbuckled helmet can come off in a crash.

name: face mask
use: Reduces the spread of germs and dust.
tip: It should cover both nose and mouth; replace disposable ones daily.

name: laptop
tip: Don't block the air vents; overheating shortens its life.

name: computer keyboard
tip: Clean it with compressed air; crumbs cause sticky keys.

name: computer mouse
use: Points and clicks on a computer screen.
tip: A mouse pad improves tracking on shiny surfaces.

name: computer monitor
tip: Keep the top of the screen at eye level to protect your neck.

name: television
use: Shows TV channels and streaming apps.
tip: Sit at least 2 metres away and keep the room lit to reduce eye strain.

name: tv remote
use: Controls the TV or set-top box from a distance.
tip: Remove batteries if unused for months to prevent leaks.

name: phone charger
tip: Use a certified charger; cheap ones can overheat and damage the phone.

name: power bank
use: Portable battery to charge phones on the go.
tip: Don't leave it charging overnight or in a hot car.

name: earphones
tip: Keep volume below 60% to protect your hearing.

name: headphones
use: Over-ear audio for music and calls.
tip: Take breaks every hour; long loud listening damages hearing.

name: bluetooth speaker
use: Plays music wirelessly from a phone.
tip: Keep it charged between 20% and 80% for a longer battery life.

name: tablet
use: Portable touchscreen for reading and video.
tip: Enable parental controls if children use it.

name: camera
tip: Keep the lens cap on when not shooting.

name: calculator
tip: Solar calculators work best near a window.

name: usb cable
tip: Don't bend it sharply at the plug; that's where it breaks first.

name: extension board
tip: Don't plug heaters or ACs into it; overload can start a fire.

name: light bulb
tip: LED bulbs use about 80% less electricity than old bulbs.

name: flashlight
use: Portable light for the dark or power cuts.
tip: Keep one with working batteries for emergencies.

name: ceiling fan
use: Circulates air to cool the room.
tip: Clean the blades monthly; dust makes the motor work harder.

name: air conditioner
tip: 24–26°C saves a lot of electricity with little loss of comfort.

name: refrigerator
tip: Don't put hot food straight in; let it cool first.

name: washing machine
tip: Leave the door open after use so it dries and doesn't smell.

name: microwave oven
tip: Never put metal or steel utensils inside.

name: toaster
tip: Unplug it before removing stuck bread; never use a knife inside.

name: electric kettle
tip: Descale it with vinegar or lemon every few weeks.

name: mixer grinder
use: Grinds masalas and makes chutney and batter.
tip: Don't fill it more than half with hot liquids.

name: induction cooktop
use: Cooks with electricity using magnetic heating.
tip: Works only with flat-bottomed steel or iron pans.

name: gas stove
use: Cooks food on an LPG flame.
tip: Turn off the cylinder regulator at night; if you smell gas, don't switch on lights.

name: gas cylinder
tip: Keep it upright and check the pipe for cracks every few months.

name: iron
tip: Never leave it face down and switched on.

name: vacuum cleaner
use: Sucks up dust from floors and sofas.
tip: Empty the dust bag before it's full to keep the suction strong.

name: smoke detector
use: Beeps loudly when it senses smoke.
tip: Test it monthly with its button.

name: fire extinguisher
tip: Remember PASS: Pull the pin, Aim at the base, Squeeze, Sweep.

name: router
tip: Change the default password and place it centrally for better signal.

name: printer
tip: Print a page every week or two so the ink doesn't dry up.

name: projector
use: Shows a large picture on a wall.
tip: Let it cool down before unplugging.

name: game controller
tip: Take a 10-minute break every hour of gaming.

name: music player
tip: Keep the volume moderate to protect your ears.

name: landline telephone
use: Voice calls over a phone line.
tip: Keep emergency numbers written next to it.

name: cd
use: Stores music, films or data on a disc.
tip: Hold discs by the edges to avoid scratches.

name: pressure cooker
use: Cooks dal, rice and vegetables fast under steam pressure.
tip: Check the gasket and whistle before cooking; never open it while pressurised.

name: frying pan
tip: Use wooden or silicone spatulas on non-stick pans.

name: tawa
use: Flat griddle for rotis, parathas and dosas.
tip: Season an iron tawa with a little oil after washing so it doesn't rust.

name: kadai
use: Deep wok for frying and curries.
tip: Don't reuse deep-frying oil more than once or twice.

name: cooking pot
use: Boils milk, tea, rice and curries.
tip: Use a lid; it saves up to a third of the cooking gas.

name: plate
tip: Steel and ceramic plates are safer than thin plastic for hot food.

name: bowl
tip: Wash promptly so food doesn't dry on.

name: spoon
tip: A teaspoon is about 5 ml, a tablespoon about 15 ml.

name: fork
tip: Keep forks away from toddlers.

name: knife
tip: A sharp knife is safer than a blunt one; cut away from your body.

name: chopping board
use: A safe surface for cutting food.
tip: Use separate boards for raw meat and vegetables.

name: rolling pin
use: Rolls out dough for rotis and puris.
tip: Dust it with a little flour so dough doesn't stick.

name: steel glass
tip: Steel is unbreakable and doesn't leach chemicals.

name: coffee mug
use: Hot drinks like tea and coffee.
tip: Chipped ceramic mugs can crack with heat; replace them.

name: teapot
tip: Rinse it well; old tea leaves turn bitter.

name: tiffin box
tip: Pack hot food only after it cools a little, to avoid sogginess and bacteria.

name: lunch box
use: Carries food to school or office.
tip: Wash and dry it fully every day.

name: jar
tip: Airtight jars keep snacks crisp and keep insects out.

name: salt container
tip: Adults should have less than 5 g of salt a day (WHO).

name: spice box
use: Keeps everyday masalas in one place.
tip: Store spices away from the stove; heat dulls their flavour.

name: chopsticks
use: Eating noodles and East Asian food.
tip: Don't stick them upright in rice; it's considered rude in many cultures.

name: drinking straw
tip: Reusable steel or bamboo straws cut plastic waste.

name: wine bottle
tip: Recycle glass separately from other waste.

name: soda can
tip: A can of cola has about 7 teaspoons of sugar.

name: cereal box
tip: Check the sugar per serving on the label.

name: milk packet
tip: Refrigerate after opening and use it within a day or two.

name: bread
tip: Check for mould before eating; store in a cool, dry place.

name: egg
tip: A fresh egg sinks in water; an old one floats.

name: banana
tip: Keep bananas separate from other fruit; they make them ripen faster.

name: apple
tip: Eat the peel; much of the fibre is there.

name: orange
use: Juicy fruit rich in vitamin C.
tip: Whole fruit has more fibre than juice.

name: mango
tip: Soak mangoes in water for a while before eating.

name: tomato
use: Used in curries, salads and chutneys.
tip: Store at room temperature for better flavour.

name: onion
tip: Store in a dry, airy basket, not the fridge.

name: potato
use: Starchy vegetable for sabzi and snacks.
tip: Don't eat green or sprouted parts.

name: grapes
use: Sweet fruit eaten fresh or dried as raisins.
tip: Wash well before eating; grapes can carry pesticide residue.

name: watermelon
tip: About 90% water, great in hot weather.

name: cake
tip: Refrigerate cream cakes.

name: burger
use: Bun with a patty and vegetables.
tip: Fast food is high in salt and fat; best as an occasional treat.

name: pizza
use: Baked flatbread with cheese and toppings.
tip: Thin crust with vegetable toppings is lighter.

name: ice cream
tip: Don't refreeze melted ice cream.

name: noodles
tip: Instant noodles are high in salt; add vegetables for nutrition.

name: biscuit packet
tip: Check the expiry date and sugar content on the label.

name: chocolate
tip: Dark chocolate has less sugar than milk chocolate.

name: chair
tip: Keep your feet flat and back supported to avoid back pain.

name: table
use: A surface for eating, studying or working.
tip: Keep sharp corners covered when toddlers are around.

name: bed
tip: Adults need 7–9 hours of sleep.

name: mattress
tip: Flip or rotate it every few months.

name: pillow
tip: Wash pillow covers weekly.

name: blanket
tip: Air it in sunlight to freshen it.

name: sofa
tip: Vacuum under the cushions to remove dust.

name: cupboard
tip: A few neem leaves or naphthalene balls keep insects away.

name: mirror
tip: Clean it with newspaper and a little vinegar for a streak-free shine.

name: clock
tip: Replace the battery when it starts running slow.

name: door
use: Entrance to a room or house.
tip: Lock it even when you're at home at night.

name: door handle
tip: One of the most touched surfaces; wipe it regularly.

name: window
use: Lets in light and fresh air.
tip: Open windows daily for ventilation.

name: curtain
tip: Thick curtains help keep rooms cool in summer.

name: bucket
use: Holds water for bathing or cleaning.
tip: Keep it covered or empty; standing water breeds mosquitoes.

name: plastic bath mug
tip: Rinse and dry it to prevent algae.

name: broom
tip: Store it upright or hung so the bristles last.

name: mop
tip: Add a disinfectant to the mopping water.

name: dustbin
tip: Separate wet and dry waste (green and blue bins).

name: toothbrush
tip: Replace it every 3 months, or sooner if the bristles splay.

name: toothpaste
tip: A pea-sized amount is enough; use fluoride toothpaste.

name: soap
use: Cleans hands and body, removes germs.
tip: Wash hands for at least 20 seconds.

name: towel
tip: Dry it in sunlight and don't share towels.

name: shampoo bottle
tip: Rinse thoroughly; residue can cause dandruff.

name: tissue box
tip: Throw used tissues away right away to stop germs spreading.

name: candle
use: Light during power cuts or for decoration.
tip: Never leave a lit candle unattended.

name: diya
use: Traditional oil lamp for prayers and festivals.
tip: Keep it away from curtains and paper decorations.

name: incense stick
tip: Ventilate the room; the smoke can irritate lungs.

name: plant pot
use: Grows plants indoors or on a balcony.
tip: Make sure it has a drain hole so roots don't rot.

name: teddy bear
use: Soft toy for comfort and play.
tip: Wash soft toys regularly; they collect dust mites.

name: ladder
tip: Keep three points of contact and never stand on the top step.

name: tripod
use: Holds a camera or phone steady.
tip: Hang your bag on its hook for stability in wind.

name: pen
tip: Cap it after use so it doesn't dry out.

name: pencil
use: Writing and drawing that can be erased.
tip: HB is best for everyday writing.

name: notebook
tip: Date each page; it makes revision easier.

name: book
tip: Read in good light, about 30 cm from your eyes.

name: scissors
tip: Pass them handle-first and keep them away from small children.

name: stapler
tip: Use the right size of staples for your stapler.

name: paper clip
tip: A handy tool for ejecting phone SIM trays.

name: eraser
tip: Keep it clean; a dirty eraser smudges.

name: ruler
use: Draws straight lines and measures length.
tip: A 30 cm ruler equals about one foot.

name: envelope
tip: Write the PIN code clearly for faster delivery.

name: playing cards
tip: A good family game; keep screen time low.

name: dice
use: Board games like Ludo and Snakes & Ladders.
tip: The opposite faces of a standard die add up to 7.

name: medicine strip
use: Tablets or capsules prescribed for illness.
tip: Check the expiry date; don't stop antibiotics early.

name: medicine bottle
tip: Measure syrup with the cup provided, not a kitchen spoon.

name: syringe
tip: Use a new syringe every time and dispose of it safely.

name: first aid kit
use: Bandages and medicines for small injuries.
tip: Check and restock it every six months.

name: bandage
tip: Clean the wound before covering it.

name: pulse oximeter
tip: Below 94% oxygen needs a doctor's advice.

name: hand sanitizer
use: Kills germs when soap isn't available.
tip: Use one with at least 60% alcohol; keep it away from flames.

name: tweezers
tip: Clean them with alcohol before and after use.

name: weighing scale
tip: Weigh yourself at the same time each day for consistent readings.

name: dumbbell
tip: Warm up first and keep your back straight while lifting.

name: yoga mat
use: Cushions and grips during yoga or exercise.
tip: Wipe it after use.

name: cricket bat
tip: Oil a new willow bat and knock it in before playing.

name: football
tip: Check the pressure; an over-inflated ball hurts on impact.

name: tennis ball
tip: Great for practice; wear eye protection for fast play.

name: badminton racket
tip: Store it in a cover away from heat so the strings keep their tension.

name: skipping rope
tip: Jump on a soft surface to protect your knees.

name: treadmill
tip: Clip the safety key to your clothes.

name: screwdriver
tip: Match the tip to the screw head so it doesn't slip.

name: hammer
tip: Hold it near the end of the handle for more force and control.

name: pliers
tip: Use insulated pliers for electrical work.

name: tape measure
tip: Lock it before reading; let it retract slowly.

name: drill machine
use: Drills holes in walls and wood.
tip: Check for hidden wires before drilling a wall.

name: padlock
tip: Oil it once a year so it doesn't jam.

name: sewing needle
tip: Store needles in a pincushion, not loose in a drawer.

name: bicycle
tip: Wear a helmet and use lights at night.

name: motorcycle
tip: Always wear a helmet; it cuts the risk of head injury by around 70%.

name: scooter
tip: Check tyre pressure every two weeks.

name: car
tip: Everyone, including rear passengers, should wear a seat belt.

name: car tyre
tip: Replace tyres when the tread is below 1.6 mm.

name: steering wheel
tip: Hold it at 9 and 3 o'clock for best control.

name: auto rickshaw
tip: Ask for the meter, or agree on the fare before the ride.

name: bus
tip: Keep your phone and wallet in front pockets in crowds.

name: traffic light
tip: Red: stop. Amber: slow down. Green: go carefully.

name: fire hydrant
tip: Never park in front of one.

name: license plate
tip: India now uses high-security registration plates (HSRP).

name: baby stroller
tip: Always use the harness and the brakes when stopped.

name: dog
tip: Vaccinate pets against rabies every year.

name: cat
tip: Deworm and vaccinate pet cats regularly.
